pb-forms.heading: Client data entry
pb-forms.boundary: Review the source, approve the mapping, then approve each exact submit. A response is checked against the saved record.
pb-forms.planned: Client browser access is planned pending a lawyer’s review of the permission rule.
pb-forms.manual: Meanwhile, work in the client system manually. Government and seller portals are refused. Dynamic or autosaving forms stay manual.
pb-forms.rowHelp: Count data rows from 1, after the header. The selected ID must be unique in this file.
pb-forms.stale: This source or client changed. Old values and approvals are hidden.
pb-forms.allowed: The client permits this exact site and work.
pb-forms.staff: I use a revocable staff login, not shared owner credentials.
pb-forms.signInHelp: Type passwords only in the client window. Remembering a sign-in is optional and stays on this computer until Forget clears it.
pb-forms.captureHelp: Use the separate client window. Capture again after filling or any page change.
pb-forms.loginHelp: Sign-in approval is separate. It never counts as a client record being saved.
pb-forms.postHelp: One request to this address. Hidden values stay private in the browser and are bound to this approval.
pb-forms.responseHelp: A response arrived. Select the actual saved fields before calling this record correct.
pb-forms.comparison.matches: Saved fields match the selected source.
pb-forms.comparison.saved-differently: Saved values differ. Inspect manually; no automatic retry.
pb-forms.comparison.not-checked: The saved identity is not verified. Do not call this complete.
pb-forms.error.REQUEST_FAILED: This record could not be refreshed. Review it again before acting.
pb-forms.error.FORM_DESKTOP_REQUIRED: Use the desktop app for the client browser. The phone can review source and results.
pb-forms.error.RULE_UNCONFIRMED: Browser access waits for the lawyer’s permission-rule review. Use the manual path meanwhile.
pb-forms.error.FORM_SOURCE_INVALID: Choose a bounded client CSV, its unique record-ID column and an existing data row.
pb-forms.error.FORM_RECORD_EXISTS: This record already has an entry. Review its current outcome.
pb-forms.error.FORM_SOURCE_CHANGED: The source changed. Refresh and review it again.
pb-forms.error.APPROVAL_STALE: This approval is old. Review the current record again.
pb-forms.error.FORM_PRIVACY_PENDING: Saved sign-in cleanup is pending on this computer. Finish Forget before opening another client browser.
pb-forms.state.submitting: Submit is in progress. Do not retry.
pb-forms.state.response: Response received, saved record not checked yet.
pb-forms.state.sign-in-response: Sign-in response received. No client record was verified.
pb-forms.state.outcome-unknown: It may have been saved. Inspect the client system manually. This entry will not retry.
pb-forms.screenshotUnavailable: No safe approval screenshot is available. Review each exact field; batch submission is not offered.
